page_name: 整体闭环极限时间引擎5.0.2版
purpose: mechanically materialize remotely fetched frozen source into Python before resolving run_verifier
python_materialization_contract: Fetch the entire source file as text; metadata-only or partial reads are invalid.
Create one fresh Python namespace with __name__ set to a value other than __main__.
Compile and execute the fetched source text in that same namespace.
After execution, assert that namespace['run_verifier'] exists and is callable.
Only then start REAL_START timing immediately before calling namespace['run_verifier']().
Record REAL_END immediately after successful return.
Do not resolve run_verifier from an empty namespace, a different namespace, or file metadata.
forbidden: Scanning C drive for a preexisting capsule when remote GitHub access works
Calling run_verifier before the fetched source text has been executed
Using a namespace different from the one receiving exec()
Editing the fetched source in Reality
Falling back silently after remote auth/network/repository failure
